title: helichrysum angustifolium subsp. serotinum
intro: Helichrysum angustifolium subsp. serotinum, commonly known as Early Gold or Yellow Mountain Cranberry, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce stress and anxiety, and support overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum angustifolium subsp. serotinum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic acids, have been identified as the primary sources of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
